title: Central does not show sessions started locally on a remote host
outcome: Central lists the sessions a remote host started locally, under the remote project bound to them, so Greg can see the sessions and work on that host from the UI.
acceptance: A session started locally on a remote host, in a project that Central has bound as a remote project, appears in Central's state under that remote project, and its status follows the host's state.
A remote host's local session that ends or is removed there leaves Central's list, and sessions in projects Central has not bound are not imported.
Tests cover import, update and removal of remote-local sessions without changing how Central-created proxy sessions behave.
